create_Version_instance: create a Version object from a version string like '1.2.3-dev' with optional major override
summarize_Version_str: summarize the Version class __str__ method that returns idiomatic version strings like '1.2.3-dev'
build_Version_pep440: build a PEP440-compliant version string from a Version instance with dev or pre tags
test_Version_ruby: test the Version ruby method that returns a four-part version string with tag appended
run_mako_plugin: run the mako_plugin function to expand version strings for all supported languages in settings
